messages:
Asha (People Ops): Quick follow-up from the all-hands Q&A: condensed answers about promotion timing, appeals, and benefits. Post any last clarifying questions here and we'll update the Notion page.

Luca (Eng): Thanks. 2 quick ones: will promo effective dates align with pay periods? and is there a separate process for role transfers (eng -> product)?

Ben (Comp): Effective date = first full pay period after approvals (usually within 1-2 pay cycles). Retro pay only for admin error or board-approved corrections.

Asha (People Ops): For cross-org role transfers, include both managers in the packet and add a clear scope-change summary. Calibration panel will include a cross-org reviewer. Dual sign-off speeds approval.

Mina (IC2): If someone misses the manager submission deadline, is retro consideration possible?

Asha (People Ops): Missed submissions should be escalated immediately. Retro promotions are exceptional and require Exec sponsor + People Ops sign-off. Try to get manager documentation in before calibration closes.

Luca (Eng): Appeal process reminder? timeline and what to include?

Ben (Comp): Appeals open for 14 days after the manager conversation. Use the appeal form in the Notion doc, include manager notes, peer feedback, and concrete impact examples. Committee = People Ops + 2 non-involved senior managers + Comp rep. Aim to close within 10 business days.

payroll-bot: Payroll note: Merit/market changes processed after approvals -> effective first full pay period. Check payroll timelines in Notion.

Asha (People Ops): Office hours set for next Wed 10am PT (managers) and Thu 4pm PT (ICs). Notion link with templates & checklist posted: https://redwoodinference.notion.site/Promo-Calibration-1778004321. DM us for urgent exceptions. :thumbsup:
